text: I am asking on behalf of the residents of Soudan Avenue for some coordinated support from Transportation Services to address some urgent concerns relating to traffic safety. Soudan Avenue is a residential street located immediately south of Eglinton Avenue, running between Bayview Avenue and Yonge Street. For the next several years Soudan Avenue will face immense traffic impacts due to the construction of the Crosstown LRT and several private developments in the immediate area. The Crosstown LRT is the largest transit expansion project in North America. While the Crosstown LRT once constructed will be an incredible benefit for our community, its construction is also creating significant issues for the community.
